entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this helmet I bought. Your hold times are a complete joke.
I certainly apologize for the wait, and I can definitely look into that return for you. Do you have the order number handy?
It's VF-654-321. Look, let's make this fast. The thing is brand new, the box unopened. I want my money back.
Okay, I'm pulling up that order now. Just to be sure I'm logging this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Are you listening to me? The box is unopened! I bought it for my son, and he decided he wanted a different color. This isn't complicated. Are you going to process this or do I need to speak to your manager right now?
There's no need for a manager, sir, I can absolutely handle this for you. I just have to ask a few standard questions. One moment while I review the policy against your purchase date.

You'd better. I swear, if you try to give me some runaround about hygiene or safety contaminants on a product that's never been used, I will write a review on every single website I can find. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration, sir, but there's no issue here. I see the helmet was delivered 81 days ago. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you're well within the window for a full refund.
Oh. So you're just... approving it? Just like that?
Yes, of course. It's within our policy. I've just authorized the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Do you see it?
Let me check... Yeah, it just came through. Huh. Okay then.

Perfect. Just attach that label to the original box and drop it off at any authorized shipping center. Once we receive it, the refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
